data_quality.note_sub6mm: 93 sub-6mm lesions are incidental findings recorded in large-cohort patients alongside their qualifying ≥10mm lesion. They are excluded from primary distributions.
data_quality.note_scanner_series: 3451 series = supine + prone acquisitions × multiple reconstruction series per scan (soft tissue, bone window, lung window, scout topogram). ~33 series per patient is expected for this protocol.
